ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, H is above, W is at the lower left, and A is at the lower right; the three points form a large triangle. P is located on side HA, and segment WP connects from W to P. In the figure, H, P, and A are on the same straight line, so ray HP and ray HA have the same direction, and ∠WHP is ∠WHA. Reasoning: The problem gives that WP is a perpendicular bisector; according to the specified method, interpret it as WP being perpendicular to HA at P, so ∠HPW = 90°. In right triangle WHP, the sum of the three interior angles is 180°. It is known that m∠WHA = 8q + 17, and ∠WHP = ∠WHA, so ∠WHP = 8q + 17; also m∠HWP = 10 + q. Therefore (8q + 17) + (10 + q) + 90 = 180. Combining gives 9q + 117 = 180, so 9q = 63, q = 7.

raw_record.question_text: If $\overline{W P}$ is a perpendicular bisector, $m \angle WHA=8q+17$, $m \angle HWP=10+q$, $AP=6r+4$, and $PH=22+3r$, find $q$.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: H, W, and A form a large triangle; P lies on segment HA, and segment WP is drawn from W to P. Since the text says WP is a perpendicular bisector, interpret WP as perpendicular to HA at P, so angle HPW is 90 degrees. Use the image to note that ray HP is the same line as ray HA, so angle WHP is the same as angle WHA. From the text, m∠WHA = 8q + 17 and m∠HWP = 10 + q. In right triangle WHP, set (8q + 17) + (10 + q) + 90 = 180 and solve for q.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: W is connected to H and A, P lies on side HA, and WP runs from W to the midpoint/perpendicular point on HA. Since WP is the perpendicular bisector of HA, W lies on the perpendicular bisector of HA, so WH = WA. Therefore triangle WHA is isosceles with base HA, giving base angles ∠WHA and ∠HAW equal. Also, in this isosceles setup, the segment from the vertex W to the midpoint P of the base HA bisects the vertex angle, so ∠HWP = ∠PWA. Use the text values: each base angle is 8q + 17 and each half of the vertex angle is 10 + q. Then the full triangle angle sum gives 2(8q + 17) + 2(10 + q) = 180, which solves to q = 7.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中有一个三角形 W-H-A，W 在左下方，H 在上方，A 在右下方。点 P 位于边 HA 上，线段 WP 从 W 连到 P。图中还出现了 Q 和 X，但求 q 时主要用到三角形 WHA 以及线段 WP。

推理：题目给出 WP 是垂直平分线。按指定方法，WP 是 HA 的垂直平分线，所以 W 在 HA 的垂直平分线上，因此 WH = WA。于是三角形 WHA 是等腰三角形，底边是 HA，所以底角相等：∠WHA = ∠HAW = 8q + 17。又因为等腰三角形中，从顶点 W 到底边中点 P 的线段 WP 也平分顶角，所以 ∠HWP = ∠PWA = 10 + q。三角形 WHA 的内角和为 180°，因此：2(8q + 17) + 2(10 + q) = 180。展开得 16q + 34 + 20 + 2q = 180，即 18q + 54 = 180，所以 18q = 126，q = 7。
